heading_path: Assisted Living in Springfield - Maple Grove Senior Living

small_chunks.text: Assisted living at Maple Grove Senior Living gives Springfield seniors daily support without giving up independence. Residents keep their own apartments and routines. Licensed staff help with medication, bathing, and dressing whenever help is wanted. Families get a partner they can reach at any hour of the day.

big_chunks.title: Frequently Asked Questions About Cost
heading_path: Assisted Living in Springfield - Maple Grove Senior Living

small_chunks.text: Maple Grove Senior Living charges one monthly fee that covers rent, meals, housekeeping, and scheduled transportation. Care services are billed in four levels, and our team reassesses the level with families each quarter. Most residents pay between four and six thousand dollars per month depending on apartment size and care level. Veterans benefits and long-term care insurance can offset part of the fee, and the billing office helps families file both. A refundable deposit holds an apartment for up to thirty days while a family decides. Respite stays are offered by the week when a caregiver needs a break, and those stays include the same meals, housekeeping, and care services that long-term residents receive every day.
